en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing a festive, decorated narrow street with garlands, flags, and small trees along the sidewalks. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand in the street. The architecture is typical of European townhouses and shops. Printed white text at the bottom right reads "NIJMEGEN, 1e WALSTRAAT". Faint mirrored postal markings appear in the sky area above the street.
